still_open.problem: The code is right, and the single-quote hole is closed and pinned: reverting _QUOTED fails three tests, and the four-shell sweep found no hidden run. Two rules that ORCH-2 and caller-identity.md state are still not pinned by any test. (1) A quoted string holds no character below U+0020 and no U+007F. In a scratch copy, _QUOTED = r"'[^']*'" keeps all 76 caller, shell and runner tests passing, and so does letting a tab in. The tables test newline and carriage return only in bare text, and the property alphabet holds no other control character. (2) A quoted string may follow a bare word only when that word ends with '='. Changing the prefix to (?:(?!=)[SAFE]*)? keeps all 76 tests passing, and no table holds "vsdd survey a'b'".
still_open.proposed_fix: Add "vsdd survey 'a\tb'", "vsdd survey 'a\nb'", "vsdd survey 'a\rb'", "vsdd survey 'a\x00b'", "vsdd survey 'a\x1bb'", "vsdd survey 'a\x7fb'" and "vsdd survey a'b'" to REFUSED_CALLS, so the regex-alone test covers them. Add the other control characters and DEL to the alphabet of the property test's between-quotes position.

still_open.problem: The program path may start with '%', '-' or '+'. bash 3.2, bash 5.3, macOS /bin/sh and zsh read a first word that starts with '%' as a job spec. So 'VSDD_CALLER=<key> %/vsdd survey' runs the fg builtin ('no job control', or 'no such job' under set -m), not the path; only dash runs the path. Through the runner, an agent's '%/vsdd survey' got the marker, 'allow' and updatedInput for a command that does not run vsdd. Nothing harmful ran, because a fresh shell has no job to resume. It is the same gap fix-4-C1-1 closed for '='. A '-' or '+' start does run, but bin/vsdd is a #!/bin/sh script. sh receives the path as its first argument and reads it as options ('-/: invalid option'), so such a call is approved and can never work.
still_open.proposed_fix: Let the path start only with a letter, a digit, '_', '.' or '/', for example (?:vsdd|[A-Za-z0-9_./][A-Za-z0-9_@%+:,./-]*/vsdd). Say so, with the reason, in caller-identity.md. Add '%/vsdd survey', '%1/vsdd x', '-x/vsdd survey' and '+/vsdd survey' to REFUSED_CALLS and to the runner refusal test.

still_open.problem: The brief asks that every ledger bypass form become a test showing that an agent's call gets no marker and no decision. Only 11 of the 31 LEDGER_BYPASS_FORMS entries go through the runner as an agent. The other 20 are checked only through is_vsdd_call and the regex. They include forms the ledger records as having got marker, 'allow' and updatedInput, such as 'vsdd survey "${(e):-\$(id)}"', "vsdd survey $'\'';id;'x'" and 'vsdd survey ${x@P}'. The exact recorded form 'vsdd survey $(echo pwned > /dev/null)$((1))' (S3R-hook-runner-C2-1) is missing. A scratch run confirmed that all of them pass unmarked and undecided, so only the tests fall short.
